Name: Even More Dialogue - Sebastian 1.6 Compatible
Author: OSlySLy
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]THIS MOD IS OUTDATED BUT FULLY COMPATIBLE WITH 1.6.[/color]
[color=#ffff00]It may conflict with dialogue updates made by Concerned Ape[/color].
[color=#ff0000](You may lose out on some 1.6+ dialogue if this mod is installed.)[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17330][color=#ff0000]
[/color]
﻿[/url]﻿Ever wanted to talk to a character in Stardew Valley and get even more dialogue responses?
Well here ya go.[/size]

[size=3]This mod makes Sebastian a little more immersive, and even improves his mood over time.
[color=#00ff00](New dialogue will likely repeat, as it's mostly dependent on your current heart level, and less on specific days.
This helps with avoiding any prompted dialogue that could be seen as uncomfortable/out of character.)[/color]
Example: Sebastian suddenly saying he wants to hold your hand, [i]when you're only at heart level 4 with him.[/i]
[/size]
[font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700]Features:[/color][/font]
[size=3]-New dialogue to fill every day/heart level. (Unmarried)[/size]
[size=3]-Added and revised dialogue when married.[/size]
[size=3]-A few extra lines of self-aware dialogue for his family.[/size]

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700][u]HOW TO INSTALL:[/u][/color][/font]
[size=3]-Download the mod folder.[/size]
[size=3]-Extract it, and place the unzipped folder in:[/size]
[size=3]Program Files/steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[size=3]-Start up Stardew Valley and you're done![/size]

[size=4]Per the 1.6 update, be sure to update your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ mod if using the 1.6 version.
[/size]
[color=#00ff00][font=Tahoma]Available Translations:[/font]
[/color][font=Tahoma][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17330]Portuguese[/url]﻿[/color][/font][size=3]: Translated by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/111289638]RenUTv[/url][size=3]﻿. (Thank You!)[/size]

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700]Dialogue Not Showing?[/color][/font]
[size=3][spoiler]You may have another dialogue mod that overwrites this mod.[/size]
[size=3](Whichever mod loads last shows up in game.)[/size]
[size=3]To fix, simply open the "manifest.json" file included in the mod folder with notepad,[/size]
[size=3]then change the name on the second line: "Even More Dialogue - Sebastian" to "Z Even More Dialogue - Sebastian",[/size]
[size=3]and then overwrite the .json file. This gives a mod more priority to be loaded last.[/size]
[size=3](Mods are loaded alphabetically for the most part.)[/spoiler][/size]

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff0000]Other Info:[/color][/font]
[size=3][spoiler]*This is just one in a series of mods I've made out of boredom and curiosity for modding.[/size]
[size=3]Expect mistakes/weird dialogue. [/size][u]This is not a very optimized mod[/u][size=3].*[/size]
[size=3]*This mod is pretty tame before marriage, but it does include a little suggestive dialogue after,[/size]
[size=3]so I can't recommend it for any younger players. It will be tagged as Adult for this reason.*[/size]
[size=3][/spoiler][/size]

[font=Tahoma][color=#00ff00]*Mod use intended for Vanilla Stardew Valley, not SVE.*[/color][/font]
[size=3]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/center][size=3]
